retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy, yellow-dominant collage featuring high-contrast black and white subjects against a graphic citrus backdrop with stencil-style typography.
triggerTerms: high contrast yellow and black poster

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, layered composition centered on a large, stylized lemon slice. Human subjects are rendered in high-contrast black and white with visible halftone textures, arranged in a dynamic diagonal line. The overall aesthetic blends clean graphic shapes with gritty, hand-stenciled textures.
coreVisualRelationships: Large circular citrus slice as a central framing device
Diagonal progression of subjects from bottom-left to top-right
High-contrast black and white figures against a saturated yellow field
Text integrated with graphic elements like a lemon slice replacing a letter
coreInvariants: Dominant yellow and orange color palette
Rough, distressed edges on graphic elements and text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are arranged in a staggered diagonal line, increasing in scale from the bottom-left to the dominant figure on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A large, stylized lemon slice in the upper center serves as the primary anchor for the title.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of the band members upward to the right, then circles back to the central title and lemon graphic.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with overlapping graphic layers and textures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Bright Lemon Yellow (Background and graphic elements)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm Orange (Diagonal stripes and citrus shading)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellow/orange spectrum contrasted with zero-saturation black and white subjects.

letterConstructionRules: Variable heights and baselines for a jittery effect
Integration of graphic icons within the letterforms
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'O' is replaced by a detailed cross-section of a lemon slice with visible segments and seeds.

composition.relationshipToImage: integrated with the central lemon slice

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant display style with small, clean sans-serif for secondary metadata.
graphicDevices: Thick horizontal grunge bars underlining text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the base military/industrial stencil structure.
Captures the heavy weight and blocky nature.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a vibrant yellow background with a large, stylized lemon slice in the center. Add diagonal orange stripes at the bottom. Place five human figures in a diagonal line from bottom-left to top-right, rendered in high-contrast black and white with a halftone dot texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply heavy, distressed black stencil lettering in the upper center. Replace the letter 'O' with a lemon slice graphic. Add thick, rough black bars above and below the text.

verificationChecks: Are the people strictly black and white with halftone dots?
Is the background predominantly yellow and orange?
Does the text have a distressed, stenciled edge?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure no photographic color remains on subjects
Confirm text is legible despite distress
Check that the lemon slice 'O' aligns with the word
Verify the diagonal flow of the composition
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [High-Contrast B&W Halftone Subjects] + [Vibrant Citrus Graphic Background] + [Distressed Stencil Typography] with a [Diagonal Dynamic Layout].
